SELECT A.*, (CASE WHEN substr(A.level_actual, 2) > substr(A.level_requested, 2) THEN 'Over' ELSE '' END) AS ot_check FROM ( SELECT ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm AS attendance_ym ,em.organization_id AS employee_org ,ar.employee_no AS employee_no ,em.full_name_local AS employee_name ,em.grade_type AS grade_type ,em.grade_title AS employee_grade ,em.ATTRIBUTE10 AS actual_shift_code ,TO_CHAR(em.date_hire_subsidiary, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS date_hire_subsidiary ,ar.level_0 AS level_0 ,ar.level_1 AS level_1 ,ar.level_2 AS level_2 ,ar.level_3 AS level_3 ,ar.level_4 AS level_4 ,lgvatt_ot_level_pkg.get_ot_level(em.subsidiary_code, em.employee_number, time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'level_requested') AS level_requested ,lgvatt_ot_level_pkg.get_ot_level(em.subsidiary_code, em.employee_number, time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'level_actual') AS level_actual ,lgvatt_ot_calculation_pkg.get_ot_total(em.subsidiary_code, em.employee_number, TO_DATE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), TO_DATE(time_and_attendance_yyyymm, 'YYYYMM'), 'month_total_ot_yyyymm') AS total_overtime FROM tb_att_ot_level_info_n ar ,emp_master em WHERE ar.employee_no = em.employee_number AND ar.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND ar.time_and_attendance_yyyymm = #{attendanceYm} AND em.organization_id = #{orgId} ) A WHERE 1 = 1
AND A.actual_shift_code = #{shiftCode}
AND UPPER(A.employee_no) = UPPER(#{empNo})
AND UPPER(A.employee_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{empName}) || '%'
AND substr(A.level_actual, 2) > substr(A.level_requested, 2)
ORDER BY A.employee_no asc
